resume_behavior: Each repository/website target stores one current-working-tree TAR.GZ plus a manifest, checksums and one compact state checkpoint. The APK item stores the current four APK dependencies with hashes. Git/commit/push history is never archived by Internet Archive. Wayback is limited to live website URLs; public Git origins are preserved separately by Software Heritage.

software_heritage.link_resolution_policy: Save requests made in the current workflow run are not resolved into README links until a later workflow run.

source_of_truth: Each Internet Archive repository/website item stores archive-state/update.json. Software Heritage and APK preservation checks are merged from this workflow run. This file is the synchronized combined copy.
